question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent, and how much did each spend?
sql:
SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM
    Customer c
JOIN
    Invoice i
    ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
ORDER BY
    TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 3;
